label: gym_mizu_040_receptionist_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Welcome to the Cascarrafa Gym,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].

label: gym_mizu_040_receptionist_01
text: Are you ready to challenge Gym Leader Kofu,\nthe Surging Chef?

label: gym_mizu_040_receptionist_02
text: Very well. Allow me to show you to the\nbattle court.

label: gym_mizu_040_receptionist_03
text: Of course. Please feel free to come speak to me\nwhenever you’re ready.

label: gym_mizu_040_boy_entry_01
text: Old man Kofu! Play with us! C’mon!

label: gym_mizu_040_woman_entry_01
text: I would be honored if you would try a new item\nfrom my restaurant’s menu as well.

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_entry_01
text: Sorry, everybody! I’ve got some business to take\ncare of as Gym Leader real quick-like![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_entry_02
text: I’m keepin’ someone waitin’, ya see. Please\nforgive me. I need to do this first![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_girl_entry_01
text: OK!

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_01
text: Heya, step right up! I’ve been waitin’ for ya.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_02
text: Thanks for the help over in Porto Marinada!\nYou did a mighty fine job![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_03
text: And now that I’ve got that legendary seaweed,\nI kin make some real quality dishes with it![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_04
text: But don’ expect me to go easy on ya in our\nbattle here![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_05
text: [EMPTY 28]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_06
text: At the auction, we battle with buyin’ and sellin’.\nAt my Gym, we battle in a more traditional sense![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_07
text: Moves and tactics—ever-changin’ as the\nraging sea![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_08
text: I’mma serve you a full course o’ Water-type\nPokémon! Don’t try to eat ’em, though![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_09
text: Gahaha! A loss as refreshing as the air at the\nmorning market![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_10
text: I’m just like a helpless little Magikarp to you, eh?\nFloppin’ around all willy-nilly![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_11
text: You got me good, I tell ya! What a great catch\nyou are![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_12
text: Just like a master fisher, ya held on tight till the\nlast second and reeled in victory![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_13
text: Now it’s time to hand over a Gym Badge to ya!\c\nAnd let’s get a REEL good photo together usin’ a\npose I’ve been wantin’ to try out for a while now![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_badge
text: With [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s in yer possession, Pokémon\nof up to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)] will be easier to catch and’ll listen\r\nto ya when you ask ’em to do things![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_badge_all
text: With 8 Gym Badges in yer possession, you kin\ncatch Pokémon of any level, and they’ll all listen\r\nto ya when you ask ’em to do things, too![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_waza
text: Lemme throw this in too as an extra-special\nbonus! I’m sure you kin make good use of it![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_14
text: All righty. It’s about time I headed on back to my\nrestaurant and got to preppin’ for the next wave![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_mizu_15
text: You come back to see me again now, ya hear?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

label: gym_mizu_040_receptionist_04
text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nCascarrafa Gym!
